prompt_text: Who is the best interior painting company in St. Louis MO?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” interior painting company for everyone — the best choice depends on the scope of work, budget, timeline, and whether you want a small local shop or a larger franchise. I can help you find the best fit. Quick questions before I recommend specific companies:

- Is this for a home or a commercial space?
- How many rooms / approximate square footage?
- Any special work (ceilings, trim, cabinets, wallpaper removal, repairs, high walls)?
- Your ZIP code or neighborhood in the St. Louis area?
- Target timeframe and budget range?

While you decide, here are practical tips to find and pick the best interior painter in St. Louis:

Where to look
- Google and Yelp (look for recent 4+ star reviews)
- Angi / HomeAdvisor and Houzz
- Better Business Bureau for complaints
- Nextdoor / local Facebook groups for neighborhood referrals
- Ask neighbors or building managers for recommendations

What to require and check
- Current liability insurance and worker’s comp
- Local business license if required
- Written estimate with breakdown (prep, number of coats, paint brand, labor, cleanup)
- Portfolio or photos of past work and references you can call
- Clear timeline, start date, and warranty/guarantee on workmanship
- Who will do the actual work (employees vs subcontractors)
- Cleanup and protection procedures (furniture covering, floor protection)

Key questions to ask during the estimate
- What brand and sheen of paint do you recommend—and can I use my own?
- How many coats will you apply?
- How do you handle surface prep, repairs, and staining?
- What’s your timeline for the job and daily hours on site?
- Do you require a deposit, and what’s the final payment schedule?
- Can I see proof of insurance and references?

Typical cost guidance (ballpark)
- Per room (average bedroom/living room): $300–$1,000 depending on size and prep needed
- Per square foot (interior walls): roughly $1–$4/ft² depending on complexity and paint quality
- Trim/doors/cabinets may be priced separately

If you want, tell me your ZIP code and project details and I’ll shortlist 3–5 highly rated companies or provide a tailored message you can send to painters to get apples-to-apples quotes.
